title: Raw loss has a long upper tail
evidence_locator: Target summary table, raw loss histogram, log1p(loss) histogram, and raw loss boxplot
observed_result: The saved target summary reports mean loss of $3,037.34, median loss of $2,115.57, 95th-percentile loss of $8,508.54, maximum loss of $121,012.25, and positive skewness of 3.795.
interpretation: The observed loss distribution is right-skewed, with a smaller number of larger claims contributing to the upper tail.
limitation_or_alternative_explanation: The raw histogram limits its displayed range for readability, so the full-distribution statistics and raw boxplot must be considered alongside it. High-loss claims are sparse and may strongly affect summary statistics and future model errors. This single labeled dataset cannot establish future distribution stability.
possible_october_implication: Examine model errors across the loss distribution, including high-cost claims. Retain MAE in original loss units.
